title: Batch stuck-state census has not completed

annotations.summary: No completed census pass in the last 15 minutes; the scheduled exporter is not running or failing.
annotations.user_impact: A stuck stock is unmeasurable, so nobody can tell whether users are waiting on it.
annotations.scope: Completeness of the census itself, not of the pipeline. Every registered stock must report a fresh observation; an unregistered or failing stock must not read as a healthy zero.
annotations.verification: Open https://monitor.omi.me/d/omi-batch-stuck-census; compare omi_batch_pipeline_census_registered_stocks with the number of states reporting a fresh observation. Check the scheduled batch-stock-census run and its logs.
annotations.safe_next_action: Fix the census sample (scheduler invocation, Firestore index, query error) before routing the missing stock through a manual count. Never widen the alarm instead of restoring the sample.
